headline: Margins improve; volume recovery expected ahead

highlights: EBITDA for Q2FY27 was INR 749 Mn, down -21% YoY & - 7.4% QoQ, below our estimate of INR 989 Mn.
EBITDA margin in Q2FY27 stood at INR 8.8% Mn, below our estimate of 12%.
PAT stood at INR 416 Mn, up by 465% YoY & 44% QoQ, below our estimate of INR 433 Mn.
The PAT margin increased by 379 bps YoY and 99 bps QoQ to 4.9% in Q2FY27, in line with our estimate of 5%.
valuation: Outlook and Valuation: Q2 combined strong growth in realisations with further margin expansion, despite volumes being lost to plant upgrades.
We maintain our FY27E-29E estimates and value SOMC at 15x FY29E EPS of INR 45.4, for a target price of INR 681.
Sanitaryware growth: The sanitaryware business is expected to grow approximately 20% in FY27, with management targeting a similar growth rate in FY28.
watch: Outlook and Valuation: Q2 combined strong growth in realisations with further margin expansion, despite volumes being lost to plant upgrades.
Risks to watch are gas price volatility, faucet margins under pressure from high brass prices and lower realizations in the project business.
